_schema_description: Guidance source inventory for Phase 6 rule packs. Each entry records WHERE the source lives, WHETHER we have uploaded it locally, and WHO can redistribute it. Phase 6A shipped the schema. Phase 6B shipped source-pending SSCP rule candidates. Phase 6C pins the MDCG SSCP source (uploaded_local with sha256) and adds backlog entries for adjacent statutory and guidance sources. Backlog entries that are present locally and publicly redistributable are also uploaded_local; the rest stay not_uploaded. Phase 6E-prep-A adds derived_md_* optional fields and bumps schema to v2.

sources.title: MDCG 2019-9 Rev.1 - Summary of safety and clinical performance: A guide for manufacturers and notified bodies
sources.redistribution_note: Public MDCG guidance issued by the Medical Device Coordination Group. The MDCG document footer states it is not legally binding and only the Court of Justice of the European Union can give binding interpretations of Union law. Freely consultable on health.ec.europa.eu. official_url is a public lookup locator, not a SHA-256-verified remote object. See docs/THIRD_PARTY.md. Not licensed under Apache-2.0.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2017/745 (MDR) - Article 32: Summary of safety and clinical performance
sources.redistribution_note: EU regulation; legal text published in the Official Journal of the European Union and freely available via EUR-Lex. Article 32 is the statutory basis for the SSCP obligation and the required content aspects (a)-(h). The local copy is a plain-text extract of the canonical EUR-Lex Article 32 text and is suitable as a source of statutory excerpts for SSCP rules whose underlying obligation is statutory. See docs/THIRD_PARTY.md. Not licensed under Apache-2.0.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2017/745 (MDR) - Article 61: Clinical evaluation (and related Annex XIV)
sources.redistribution_note: EU regulation; legal text freely available via EUR-Lex. Article 61 governs clinical evaluation and the relationship between CER, SSCP, and PMCF. Annex XIV is referenced from Article 61 and is the structural anchor for clinical evaluation content; the Annex XIV text is NOT extracted in the local article_61.txt and remains a Phase 6D+ task (use the eu-mdr-2017-745-full-text reference below for the unabridged content if needed). See docs/THIRD_PARTY.md. Not licensed under Apache-2.0.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2017/745 (MDR) - full regulation text (HTML/XML export from EUR-Lex)
sources.redistribution_note: Canonical EUR-Lex export of MDR 2017/745. Reference copy for future statutory-extract work (Annex XIV, Annex III, Articles 83-86, etc.). Not directly quoted by Phase 6C rules; serves as the source of truth for derived article-level extracts. See docs/THIRD_PARTY.md. Not licensed under Apache-2.0.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2017/745 (MDR) - Articles 83-86 and Annex III (post-market surveillance, PSUR)
sources.redistribution_note: Statutory basis for PMS and PSUR. Full MDR text is locally available under eu-mdr-2017-745-full-text but a focused article-level extract has not been produced yet. Inventory placeholder; promote to uploaded_local in a future packet that extracts the relevant article texts. See docs/THIRD_PARTY.md. Not licensed under Apache-2.0.

sources.title: EUDAMED functional/user guidance for SSCP module (upload, indexing, Basic UDI-DI association)
sources.redistribution_note: EUDAMED user/functional guidance for the SSCP module. No specific PDF is uploaded locally yet; official_url remains null until a document is pinned. The schema source_type enum does not include 'EUDAMED' so the closest existing value 'other' is used. See docs/THIRD_PARTY.md.

sources.title: EU Commission guidance - Summaries of clinical trial results for laypersons (under Regulation (EU) No 536/2014)
sources.redistribution_note: EU Commission guidance on layperson summaries under the Clinical Trials Regulation. Public document; freely consultable on health.ec.europa.eu. Tangentially relevant to the patient/lay section of an SSCP (cross-reference for readability discipline); not the direct statutory basis for SSCP content. Used as an inventoried reference, not quoted in Phase 6C rules. official_url is a public lookup locator, not a SHA-256-verified remote object. See docs/THIRD_PARTY.md. Not licensed under Apache-2.0.

sources.title: TEAM-NB / notified-body interpretation papers on SSCP
sources.redistribution_note: TEAM-NB position papers represent the interpretation of a notified-body industry association and are explicitly NOT statutory. Redistribution terms can be restrictive; the inventory entry stays not_uploaded and official_url remains null. Do not commit TEAM-NB PDFs. TEAM-NB content may inform internal reviewer checklists but must never override MDR or MDCG source material. See docs/THIRD_PARTY.md.

sources.title: MDCG 2022-9 Rev.1 - Summary of safety and performance for IVDs (SSP) template
sources.redistribution_note: Public MDCG guidance for the IVDR SSP (sister framework to the MDR SSCP). Out of scope for the current SSCP rule pack; included as inventory anchor for a future IVDR SSP pack. document_family is 'OTHER' because the schema enum does not yet carry an IVDR_SSP value. official_url is a public lookup locator, not a SHA-256-verified remote object. See docs/THIRD_PARTY.md. Not licensed under Apache-2.0.
